name: Anthropology
notes: Ten courses, of which at least eight must be at the 200 level or higher. Modeled as max100Level 2.
ANTH 101 is normally taken before the spring semester of the sophomore year; ANTH 200 is normally taken in the sophomore year and has ANTH 101 as a prerequisite.
The department also offers a separate BA in Medical Anthropology, encoded as major-medanth-ba.
Honors requires a research project (minimum 4 credits) and an additional theory course - not modeled.
Transfer cap is 5 courses (20 credit hours), subject to approval by the Director of Undergraduate Studies.
The department prefers ANTH 2xx for remaining electives.
